# Phase One — Make Radiance Tangible

The Awtsmoos renews every vessel; this continuation turns server capability truth into visible, owned, accessible product experience.

## Parallel Rivers
1. Prove Radiance backend behavior and structure.
2. Expose server-owned action testimony to product commerce UI.
3. Add purchase/unlock/owned states without client-authored pricing.
4. Apply accessible global Radiance styling only for owned products.
5. Verify mobile, focus, reduced motion, high contrast, reload and replay behavior.
6. Generate crawler-visible Apps/Games inventory and product metadata.
7. Add readiness tests so marketed capabilities cannot drift from backend truth.
